description: For a business that comes to the customer: check the service address before booking. Send it as one line, as fields, or as a place_id saved from an earlier check. The answer says whether Google confirmed it (`verdict`), the address to book with (send it as answers.address), its place_id (save both for this customer; next time send the place_id, with the apartment or unit as extended_address if there is one), and whether it is inside the area the business serves. Book when `bookable` is true; when the verdict is `confirm`, read the corrected address to the customer first. `next` says what to do otherwise.

inputSchema.description: Check a service address before booking a business that comes to the customer: whether Google confirms it, the address to book with, and whether it is inside the area the business serves.

oneOf.description: The address as one line: "123 Main St, Poway, CA 92064".

The address as fields, in any one of three spellings: schema.org PostalAddress (streetAddress, extendedAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry), the same in snake_case (street_address, extended_address, address_locality, address_region, postal_code, address_country), or line_one, line_two, city, state, postal_code, country. A street is required. Or send `place_id`, a Google Place ID saved from an earlier check of this customer's address, with the apartment or unit as extended_address if there is one.

address_country.description: A two-letter country code; US when left out.

address_region.description: The state, as its two-letter code.

place_id.description: A Google Place ID from an earlier check, alone.

name: check_address
title: Check an address
